abilities.name: Nightsun Style
_curatorNotes: Base normals (out-of-Nightsoul) are physical claymore strikes with hitmarks 21/22/44. Inside Nightsoul Blessing, the N input routes to Loop Shot (separate skill ability gated by state: "nightsoulBlessing").

chargeFrames omitted: gcsim charge.go has explicit TODOs for ActionAttack/ActionCharge/ActionSkill/ActionBurst — only Dash/Jump/Swap measured (=71 frames at chargeHitmarks[0]). Recipe convention: don't fabricate; flag and skip. The spinning claymore CA is also disabled inside Nightsoul Blessing (gcsim NextQueueItemIsValid).
plungeFrames omitted: no plunge.go in gcsim character dir.

abilities.name: Loop Shot
abilities.description: While in Nightsoul Blessing, pressing N fires Loop Shot — Kinich loops around the grappled target and lets fly two Dendro shots (hitmarks 30 and 38). Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG (gcsim AttackTagElementalArt + AdditionalTagNightsoul). Each press also generates 3 Nightsoul points (towards the 20-point Scalespiker threshold).
_curatorNotes: Schema-typed as `abilityType: "skill"` with `input: ["N"]` (Lanyan-shape) — gcsim categorises Loop Shot as SkillState with AttackTagElementalArt and ICDTagKinichLoopShot, so authoring as skill is more truthful than a normal-attack entry that would inherit normal-attack ICD/scaling.

Two-press alternation: each Loop Shot press fires 2 hits (skillAttackHitmarks=[[30,38],[31,38]]) and the press alternates between counter 0 and 1. Frames here are skillAttackFrames[0]; press-1 frames differ marginally (~1f) and are not authored — schema's single FrameMap captures the canonical case.
cooldown: 0 — gcsim doesn't call SetCD on Loop Shot. The 18s skill CD belongs to the parent Canopy Hunter cast; Loop Shot inside Nightsoul is the in-stance N replacement, freely repeatable.
noICD: true — Loop Shot has its own ICDTag (KinichLoopShot) separate from the normal-attack ICD pool. Marking noICD prevents the parser from interleaving with the normals[] ICD counter.

Charged Attack is disabled inside Nightsoul Blessing (gcsim NextQueueItemIsValid blocks ActionCharge/LowPlunge/HighPlunge); chargeFrames not authored on this skill entry — pressing C while in Nightsoul will not produce a valid action. This is a caveat the timeline can't render cleanly; user assumes responsibility for valid sequencing.
IgnoreInfusion: true in gcsim — Loop Shot is fixed Dendro and does not inherit external infusions. Schema renders skill abilities using character.element (dendro) which matches.

abilities.name: Canopy Hunter: Riding High
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the Hold form, which aims the grapple. Charged attacks are disabled during Nightsoul's Blessing, but the timeline will still show one if you add it.
_curatorNotes: behavior: "stance" + opensState: "nightsoulBlessing" — Mizuki/Xilonen-shape. Opens both inStance and nightsoulBlessing for the 10s window. The in-stance N (Loop Shot) and in-stance E (Scalespiker Cannon) gate on nightsoulBlessing for crispness.
terminatesOnSwap: true — gcsim onExitField subscribes OnCharacterSwap and calls cancelNightsoul() when blessing is active.

duration: 10 reflects gcsim EnterTimedBlessing(0., 10*60+10, ...) — base Nightsoul timer is 10s. Actual exit can be earlier if Nightsoul points drain to 0 (1pt/0.5s base time-pass + 3pt/Loop Shot − 20pt/Cannon — drains under heavy Cannon use), or later if A1 (Burning/Burgeon → +7pt) regen extends. Resource pool not modelled per the constitution (windows not gauges).
cooldownStartDelay: 9 — gcsim schedules SetCD inside a Task at skillStart=9 frames after cast. Equivalent to SetCDWithDelay(skill, 18s, 9f).
Hold variant: gcsim adds +hold frames before Nightsoul entry (cap 300f / 5s); cooldownStartDelay grows accordingly. Not authored — tap form is the standard rotation case.
While already in Nightsoul, pressing E re-routes to Scalespiker Cannon (separate skill entry gated by state: "nightsoulBlessing"). The base entry above is the cold-open press (out-of-Nightsoul).
Particle generation: 5 Dendro particles on Scalespiker Cannon hit (gcsim particleCB), not on the cold-open E. Energy generation isn't modelled at the ability level.
abilities.description:
Kinich uses his big-game hunting skills to either move swiftly or attack his opponent.
When there is an opponent or object that can be attacked nearby, he will attach a grappling hook to the target and enter Nightsoul's Blessing with 0 Nightsoul points. If neither is nearby, he fires a grappling hook forward and swings in mid-air, and this Skill's CD is decreased by 60%.
This skill can be Held to release. When it is Held, Kinich can aim the grappling hook.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kinich
Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing lasts 10s and generates 2 Nightsoul points every second.
In this state, Kinich will hook onto a nearby opponent and perform a variable attack:
·When using a Normal Attack, Kinich will fire Loop Shots as he loops around the grappled target based on his current movement direction, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG and generating 3 Nightsoul points. Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Nightsoul points are at max, he can use the Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Consume all Nightsoul points to deal Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG. When "Scalespiker Cannon" is Held, Kinich can aim this shot. After firing the Cannon, Kinich will try to grapple to its target.
While in Nightsoul's Blessing, after grappling an opponent or firing "Scalespiker Cannon," a Blind Spot will be generated next to the opponent. When Kinich enters this Blind Spot, it will disappear and he will generate 4 Nightsoul points.
If the grapple connection should snap due to exceeding the maximum distance or some other reason, using a Normal Attack will establish a new connection with a nearby opponent before performing Loop Shots.

abilities.name: Scalespiker Cannon
abilities.description: While in Nightsoul Blessing with maximum Nightsoul points (20), pressing E consumes all points to fire Scalespiker Cannon — a single Dendro hit landing 12 frames after release. The cannon snapshot is taken before points drain (gcsim ScalespikerCannon flow). Frames here are the Tap variant (release at frame 35); Hold release shifts to frame 17 with up to 180 extra hold frames.
_curatorNotes: Schema-typed as in-stance E re-press, gated on state: "nightsoulBlessing" — same shape as Cyno Mortuary Rite. Per project_tier_c_architecture_plan, the actual in-game gate is "max Nightsoul points" (a stacks condition), but the stacks primitive is deferred. Authoring on nightsoulBlessing is the closest fit; the user asserts they have max points by typing E during the 10s window.
cooldown: 0 — gcsim ScalespikerCannon does not call SetCD. The 18s skill CD belongs to the cold-open Canopy Hunter cast.
Frames are the tap variant (releaseFrame=35 + scalespikerFrames per next action). Hold variant: releaseFrame=17 + up to 180f hold; not authored — tap is the standard rotation case.
Particle generation: 5 Dendro particles on Scalespiker hit (gcsim particleCB, gated by particlesGenerated bool — fires at most once per Nightsoul instance).

A4 Flame Spirit Pact: gcsim ai.FlatDmg += 3.2 × hunters_experience_stacks × ATK on the Cannon hit (max 2 stacks → 640% ATK FlatDmg). Stacks-gated FlatDmg scaling is the deferred-stacks gap (see project_tier_c_architecture_plan); not authored as a damage effect because scaling 320 ATK "per stack at max" misrepresents the mechanic. Flagged on the A4 passive entry.

abilities.name: Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord
_curatorNotes: Burst hits at burstHitMark=161 frames (2.68s after cast). Ajaw summon spawns at the slash hit; mobility "follows" since gcsim's QueueLaser fires from the active char's position toward primary target.

Dragon Breath laser ticks (P3): gcsim ajawHitmarks=[145,150]f randomised (avg 2.45s), first tick at ajawFirstHitmark=253f from cast = 92f from spawn (=1.53s firstTickDelay). dragonBreath multiplier 217.32% ATK Dendro at TalentLvl 10. The 6-laser cap (gcsim step==7 break) emerges naturally from interval×duration math: 1.53 + 5×2.45 = 13.78s, well within the 15s window.

Nightsoul extension: if Q is cast while Kinich is already in Nightsoul Blessing, the blessing duration is extended by 1.7s (gcsim SetNightsoulExitTimer +1.7×60). Not authored as a stanceExtension on the burst entry — stanceExtension's semantic is "in-stance ability extends parent stance," but Q is cast outside the stance pattern (Q is its own instant burst, not an in-stance ability). The 1.7s is small enough that the visible window mismatch is acceptable.
Energy consumption delay 5f (gcsim ConsumeEnergy(5)) — not modelled separately.
abilities.description:
Unleashes the power of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw (on a limited, conditional, restricted, contractual, partial, temporary basis), dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG. Ajaw will unleash his Dragon Breath at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG.
If Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing when this is used, this Blessing's duration is extended by 1.7s.

passives.name: The Price of Desolation
_curatorNotes: Burning/Burgeon-on-Desolation-marked enemy → +7 Nightsoul points to Kinich, 0.8s ICD. Pure Nightsoul resource flow — not modelled per the constitution. The Desolation status is applied on Loop Shot/Scalespiker Cannon hit during Nightsoul (a1CB) and persists until Nightsoul ends.
passives.description: When Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing state, opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. Nightsoul points can be gained this way once every 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

passives.name: Flame Spirit Pact
passives.caveat: Stacks aren't tracked — assert them with `{huntersExperience:1}` (or 2) right before the Cannon press. Asserted before any other skill press, the buff bar shows on that cast instead of the Cannon.
_curatorNotes: Hunter's Experience: nearby Nightsoul Burst → +1 stack (max 2, 15s). Each stack consumed on Scalespiker Cannon adds 320% ATK as FlatDmg to the Cannon hit (max-stack total = 640% ATK FlatDmg).

Migrated from the deferred-stacks placeholder to the perStack-scaling BuffValue primitive (2026-05-08). value: perStack with per: { stat: atk, ratio: 320 }, maxStacks: 2. Effective resolved value at render time = effective_stacks × 320 (e.g. 2 stacks → ~640% atk).

Trigger: onCast skill (over-renders on Loop Shot and cold-open Canopy Hunter — accepted; matches the C6 bounce convention). Per-cast stackContext gating means only E presses where the user asserted huntersExperience >= 1 will show the buff. The schema has no per-ability scoping inside skill (Loop Shot vs Cannon vs cold-open) — would need an ability-id filter on the trigger to be precise.

Stack acquisition (teammate Nightsoul Burst trigger) is a separate gap — schema has no team-Nightsoul-Burst event primitive. Stacks must be user-asserted; the planner doesn't infer them from rotation.
[A7] Hunter's Experience stacks come from a nearby party member's Nightsoul Burst (max 2); acquisition isn't inferred so they must be user-asserted.
[A7] Each stack consumed on Scalespiker Cannon adds 320% ATK as FlatDmg to the Cannon hit (max +640% ATK at 2 stacks) — damage math kept out of the user-facing caveat.
[A7] The 1s buff window is a placeholder; the in-game mechanic is a single-hit FlatDmg snapshot on the Cannon hit, not a duration buff.
passives.description: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Kinich will gain 1 stack of Hunter's Experience that lasts 15s. Max 2 stacks. When Kinich uses Canopy Hunter: Riding High's Scalespiker Cannon, all stacks of Hunter's Experience will be consumed, with each stack consumed increasing the DMG dealt by this Cannon shot by 320% of Kinich's ATK.

constellations.name: Parrot's Beak
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +30% movement speed for 6s after grapple swing — out of scope; (2) Scalespiker Cannon CRIT DMG +100%. The CD bonus is per-ability scoped (only applies to AttackTagElementalArt + AdditionalTagKinichCannon); schema has no per-ability-scoped buff primitive. Removed prior placeholder critDmg buff (which would over-apply +100% CD globally). Description-only.
constellations.description:
After Kinich lands from Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

constellations.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
_curatorNotes: -30% Dendro RES on skill hit (Loop Shot or Scalespiker Cannon) for 6s. gcsim c2ResShredCB attaches to both attacks. Modelled as resShred with onHit ability=skill — fires on any skill hit which is correct for Kinich (only Loop Shot/Scalespiker hit during Nightsoul).
Second effect (first Scalespiker Cannon after entering Nightsoul: +AoE radius 3→5 + +100% DmgP) is per-instance/per-stance gated; schema has no "first-of-kind in stance" condition. Description-only.
constellations.description:
When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their Dendro RES by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.

constellations.name: Protosuchian's Claw
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hummingbird's Feather
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) +5 Energy on Loop Shot/Scalespiker hit during Nightsoul, 2.8s ICD — energy resource flow gated on specific skill-hit events; gcsim c4 attaches the energy regen and an AttackMod. Schema's onCast ability=skill would over-fire (also fires on cold-open Canopy Hunter). Skipped to avoid mis-modelling. (2) +70% Hail damage — gcsim c4 AddAttackMod adds DmgP=0.7 on AttackTagElementalBurst, effectively a permanent burstDmgBonus buff while C4 unlocked. Modelled as a passive-trigger constellation-gated burstDmgBonus +70 buff.
constellations.description:
When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
Additionally, Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord deals 70% more DMG.

constellations.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
_curatorNotes: Scalespiker Cannon bounce: 700% ATK Dendro damage to a second enemy after the initial Cannon hits. gcsim c6 fires QueueAttackWithSnap with mult=7 (=700%). Modelled as a damage effect with onHit ability=skill (fires on skill hits in general — over-fires on Loop Shot, but in practice Loop Shot multiplier is small enough that the timeline rendering is acceptable; the bounce only fires on Cannon in-game). Inherits A4/C2 buffs per gcsim (ai.FlatDmg + DmgP modifiers carry over via the snapshot).
constellations.description:
After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as Dendro DMG.
If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.
